title: Total Earned is the hero figure (larger, colored underline) and equals Started — Earned plus Ready to Invoice
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The report shows jobs in the "Approved - partially completed" tab and the "Completed" tab with non-zero earned values.
custom_steps:
1. Look at how the Total Earned figure is styled compared to the other six figures.
2. Add the Started — Earned figure to the Ready to Invoice figure.
3. Compare the sum to Total Earned.
custom_expected:
1. Total Earned is shown larger than the other figures and with a colored underline — it is the strip's hero figure.
2. Total Earned equals Started — Earned plus Ready to Invoice, to the cent.
